dedupe_keys.name: architectural security weaknesses in industrial control systems coded from ics cert advisories

description: This dataset codes publicly disclosed vulnerability advisory reports for industrial control systems by the software architecture weaknesses they reveal. The Zenodo record says the package holds the raw output listing components, common architectural weakness enumerations (CAWE) and CVE identifiers per report, frequency tables of those concerns, an ICS component term dictionary and HTML copies of the advisories studied. It was published in December 2018 by three authors at the Rochester Institute of Technology as a supplement to a 2019 IEEE International Conference on Software Architecture paper, under the CC BY 4.0 licence, free to download as one zip file of about 9.9 MB. Coverage is the set of ICS-CERT advisories studied up to 2018. Caveats: it is a research snapshot that has not been updated, and the number of advisories is not stated on the page read. For simulation it gives a coded inventory of which ICS components carry which weakness types, to parameterise cyber attack surfaces in models of plant control systems. Related catalogue records include the ICS SCADA cyber kit testbed traffic data and the Tennessee Eastman process anomaly detection data.
